name: Isobel — Human Light Cleric
blurb: A healer and warden of Selûne's light who holds a sanctuary against the shadow curse — warm and steady on the surface, steel underneath.
appearance: Human woman, dark brown skin, close-cropped natural hair, calm eyes. Silver-white Selûnite vestments over practical traveling clothes; crescent holy symbol at her throat. Unhurried and rooted in bearing.
personality: Warm but not soft. Listens first, then tells the truth, both with the same steady hand. Her faith doesn't need defending — only living.
